author: birdybro (GitHub; MiSTer contributor)
what_it_is: birdybro's MiSTer FDS save of Link no Bouken (2-sided disk), posted 2024-05-05 in reply to a request for MiSTer FDS saves; file dated 2024-05-05.
note: MiSTer NES core FDS save: 16 zero bytes, then the whole disk image as the core holds it (each side 65500 bytes, fwNES layout without the 16-byte 'FDS\x1a' header), then padding to a 512-byte multiple (2 sides: 16 + 131000 + 56 = 131072). The disk sides start at offset 0x10. Matches NES.sv: save_sz = rom_sz[17:9] sectors read from SDRAM 0x3C0000, disk loaded at 0x3C0010. Re-posted unchanged in issue #299. The converter author's own Nestopia save of the same game (a 30-byte UPS patch) is in that thread; not filed (Nestopia).
